# IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic (TrueType copies)

`IBMPlexSans-*.ttf` and `IBMPlexSansArabic-*.ttf` are the Regular and Bold weights of IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic,
converted from the WOFF2 files in `assets/fonts/plex/` to plain TrueType so the PDF export can embed the same typeface the
editor shows on screen. The glyphs and font names are unchanged.
